# Unit tests of the wiring area. Owner: WIRE
# (openspec/changes/m2-interactive-editing/design.md D2). Every *_test.cpp
# here is compiled into hefesto_wiring_tests; extra libraries or definitions go
# below.

hefesto_add_area_tests(wiring)

# Magic's scmos.tech, generated by tests/unit/tech when the reference tree
# build/ref/magic exists (the test skips otherwise).
target_compile_definitions(hefesto_wiring_tests PRIVATE
  HEFESTO_SCMOS_TECH="${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/tests/unit/tech/magic-tech/scmos.tech")
